advance_only_if: Pooled primary Macro F1 strictly improves C4, pooled H12 no worse by more than 0.001, missing-subgroup primary Macro F1 improves, and at least 4/6 primary windows have nonnegative F1 delta. Apply identically to fixed expert and conditional blend; prefer one best qualifying candidate only.
reason: Require broad evidence before spending a team slot on a small subgroup change. No public or threshold search.
chronology_note: Recorded before MAIN inspected Stage3 score output, after temporal fitting had started. This is a pre-review external-advance gate, not a pre-fit cryptographic selection freeze.
